exceptions.description: The original 40 J2/J3 lands and their plated holes remain; do not shrink them.

A separately checked offset starting inside that same existing pad land may be considered, with full-width copper contact,45-degree bends, unchanged clearances/edge limits and no use of neighboring inter-pad gaps. No untested offset or board-edge bypass receives an exception. None of the recorded offset starts is a completed accepted corner route.

prohibitions: No ordinary via, including GND stitching vias, intersects either rework zone. Existing header PTH barrels are the explicit exception.
No polygon fill/pour/zone enters the rework strips; GND is not exempt just because some header pads are GND. Keep GND lands and use explicit inward ground spokes to interior connected ground.
No outboard bypass, diagonal between neighboring contacts, longitudinal trace beside the row, or solder-mask-based exemption.
No narrower traces, clearances, lands, annuli or drills introduced to fit this rule.

audit.countsBasis: The103 segment/9 via impact inventory tests the earlier conservative centred-lead/0.50mm strip proposal against unchanged V9. It is retained evidence, not certification that this implementation can be routed or that every angled own-pad connection is forbidden by the user.

routingChangesBeforeMacro: First resolve the four mounting-hole corner conflicts and the seven front-pad conflicts. Then reserve actual checked own-pad exits and the selected rework regions; do not assume all40 centred stubs exist.
Replace the west BOOT/header-side GPIO trunks and the right VBUS/VSYS/EN/LED edge corridors; the 22 mm outer-lane benefit cannot be retained inside these zones.
Move both 3V3 east bridge vias and the VBUS sense transition/return inward, preserving their complete supply/sense/local-return graphs.
Reallocate all nine listed ordinary vias; keep signal transition returns inside the interior area.
Remove GND fill from both strips; explicitly connect each GND header pad inward to the interior return network and recheck reference coverage.
Reroute the 29 own-pad contacts that are currently diagonal/longitudinal into clean normal entries; open GPIOs also require their reserved entries.
returnConsequences: An explicit inward GND lead is permitted; a generic plane between contacts is not. Direct B-layer spokes can connect GND PTHs without adding ordinary vias beside the pads.

New service strips remove potential reference copper under the last 0.50 mm beyond the inner land edge. Preserve nearby interior ground and evaluate each signal/header return; do not assert continuous-plane or HF acceptance merely from a clean spoke.
Existing diagnostic already has 13 GND components / 12 missing GND links and the sub-1 mm² C6 island; the new rule requires a coordinated ground redesign, not the historical fill.

interfaceAssessment.preservingPicoPitch: Preserving2.54mm contact pitch and17.78mm row spacing remains an objective, not an established all40-exit result. Four centred corner leads fail on both layers with present bores; seven more fail onF against nearby component pads. No complete fixed-hole corner escape is qualified.
interfaceAssessment.outlineOnlyWidening: Increasing width alone does not fix the corner bore/edge bottleneck while header and hole locations remain. Changing hole positions, omitting a hole, altering outline end clearance or moving headers are distinct mechanical decisions; none is silently adopted.
interfaceAssessment.mechanicalOption: One explicit unadopted hypothesis shifts only H1/H2 y2.00→2.75 and H3/H4 y49.00→48.25, retaining X4.5/17.5 and2.10mm bores. This changes the mount pattern from13×47 to13×45.5mm, while keeping header positions/pitch. Its short45-degree corner lead examples pass the scoped pad/bore/edge screen; it is not an approved mechanical layout or full routing result.
